subject: Codex Labs × Redwood — pilot proposal for LangChain/LlamaIndex connector + tracing
messages:
From: Samira Shah <samira@codexlabs.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: partnerships@codexlabs.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Integration proposal: Codex Labs + Redwood (LangChain/LlamaIndex connector + tracing)

Hi Kim,

I lead partnerships at Codex Labs — we build a domain-specialized prompting and retrieval layer used by several analytics teams at mid-market SaaS companies. We're evaluating tighter integrations with inference platforms and I wanted to propose a pilot with Redwood focused on: 1) a LangChain/LlamaIndex connector that preserves trace events, 2) tracing hooks so customers can reconcile prompt/chain telemetry with Redwood tokens/latency, and 3) a small co-marketing pilot if the tech proves out.

High-level ask: do you have an integration checklist and an initial SOW we can review? Our target is a 6-week technical pilot (staging sandbox + one internal customer workload).

Attaching: Codex one-pager (link below) and a short list of non-functional constraints (latency SLOs, KV-cache expectations).

Suggested times for a 30m sync next week: Wed 10–12 PDT or Thu 13–15 PDT.

Thanks — excited to explore.

Samira Shah
Head of Partnerships, Codex Labs
samira@codexlabs.ai
https://codexlabs.ai

Attachment stubs: codex-onepager.pdf; codex-nf-constraints.txt

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Shah <samira@codexlabs.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: Codex Labs + Redwood (LangChain/LlamaIndex connector + tracing)

Hi Samira — great to meet you over email and thanks for the clear ask.

We'd love to pilot this. A couple quick items to move the conversation forward:
- I'll schedule a 30m intro with Vanessa (partner lead) and Karthik (runtime/trace owner).
- Attached: our integration checklist and an SOW stub tailored for small pilots. The checklist shows what we need from customer SDKs/adapter patterns to preserve traceable prompt/context metadata.
- Two topics to confirm on the call: (1) whether you expect an official LangChain integration (adapter + docs) vs a lighter LlamaIndex connector, and (2) what level of tracing fidelity you require (per-chain vs per-step).

Proposed slots: Wed 17 Jul 11:00–11:30 PDT or Thu 18 Jul 14:00–14:30 PDT. Let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Kim Park
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood-integration-checklist.pdf; sow-codex-draft.docx

From: Samira Shah <samira@codexlabs.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Miguel Lopez <miguel.lopez@codexlabs.ai>, partnerships@codexlabs.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: Codex Labs + Redwood (LangChain/LlamaIndex connector + tracing)

Thanks Kim — Thu 18 Jul 14:00 PDT works for us. Miguel (our engineering lead) will join — looping him in here.

Quick technical notes ahead of the call:
- We're leaning toward supporting both LangChain adapters and a LlamaIndex connector; initial priority is preserving chain-level trace events to link prompt inputs to downstream embeddings/calls.
- Our staging workload: 30k tokens/day peak, median latency target 250ms p90 for generation path; we depend on prefix caching to keep costs steady.
- Attached: a lightweight architecture diagram + our security Q&A spreadsheet (we'll need SOC2 evidence paths listed).

On tracing: does Redwood emit stable request IDs we can attach to chain telemetry? Are there recommended wire-level hooks or is the SDK recommended approach? We'll review your checklist and the SOW before the call.

Looking forward to the sync — Samira

Attachment stubs: codex-redwood-arch.png; codex-security-qna.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Codex Labs — pilot proposal (LangChain/LlamaIndex + tracing)

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding the thread from Codex. Key points from Samira's note and attachments:
- Codex wants a 6-week pilot: LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex connector that preserves chain-level trace events.
- Their staging footprint is small but latency-sensitive (p90 target ~250ms). They care about prefix/KV cache behavior and stable request IDs so their telemetry can tie back to Redwood logs.
- Ask: integration checklist + SOW review (attached). Also they submitted a security Q&A spreadsheet — will likely want SOC2 evidence links.

Proposed internal split:
- Vanessa: lead the partner side (commercial terms, co-marketing + pilot acceptance criteria).
- Karthik: scope the runtime/instrumentation work (estimate engineering effort to support trace ID passthrough and a lightweight LangChain integration example).

Karthik — can you give a 2–3 line estimate (eng weeks) and identify major blockers by EOD Monday? Vanessa — can you confirm willingness to own the pilot and I'll make intros.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Kim Park
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
